settings.intro: T-shirt Booyah is made in Iowa by an Iowan, and some of the shirts are just for us. These are the ones that make sense if you've been to a county fair, waved at a stranger on a gravel road, or marveled at an Amish horse and buggy.

settings.heading: Why Iowa
settings.text: I live here. I raise blueberries, I have opinions about loose-meat sandwiches, and I wave at every truck on a gravel road. Iowa is easy to make fun of and easier to love, and these shirts try to do both at once.

settings.heading: Not from Iowa?
settings.text: You're still welcome. These shirts are in the main shop too, next to the book carts and the particle accelerators, and they ship anywhere in the US.
